author: Dasov
quote: Gameplay feels way too dependent on the female character—if you want things to go well, Lucia has to be happy... other than that, everything is amazing, though I feel the story is too dependent on that. 5 set the bar way too high; there's no risk or madness against NPCs, just like with Wolverine, it feels like it's holding your hand.
